[[File:SpecOpsAgent-COTF.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Rebel SpecOps]] agent]]
A '''field agent''' was a position within [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. They are assigned to complete specific objectives by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence's]] [[Operations (Alliance Intelligence)/Legends|Operations]] division. After completing the mission, the operative returned to base. After twenty missions, field agents were either forced to retire or transfer to another department. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was also known to make use of field agents.
